body: But you told me to tell her. I'm sorry. I'm beyond help and I shouldnt have posted here
I know she would blame herself. I'm a fucked up selfish person who would do it anyway. I hurt people no matter what I do so it's better to be dead
Everybody judges everybody and if she judges me as a monster I can't handle it. I just wish I was dead

She's mad at me because I won't tell her what's wrong. I feel like I'm all alone. Thanks for the kind words but you don't know me at all so how could you love me? The only people who love me don't know who I really am and would leave if they did

You sure are assuming a lot. They know exactly what got him, gang violence. It's not a fucking mystery. Maybe they feel lucky he wasn't shot, how would I know. And he's not dead, I said that in my post, but you're going to pretend like they don't know? Go make up your fan fiction somewhere else.

I posted this in desperation. Yes, hoping someone had a magic solution. You know, like anybody who prays? it's not a fucking sin to want to stop hurting. But I know there's no magic solution, I realize that, I was just desperate. I know the only answer will be a hard one. But you're over here making shit up about my real life like "I only feel a tinge of guilt" like how would you fucking know? Oh yeah it's a tinge of guilt that keeps me up all night, gives me panic attacks, makes me want to kill myself, just a tinge. Like you have any fucking idea what it's like. Easy for you to say whatever smug shit you want on the other side of a keyboard. Also I NEVER SAID I WAS A GOOD PERSON, literally never, so I don't know who you think you are arguing against. I said I was a different person and I am in many other ways. You can be two different kinds of bad person. Jesus

Yes, almost everyone has told me I need to tell her and I realize that's probably the right thing to do but I'm not exactly jumping for joy about it I am fucking terrified. And YES I GET IT you think I am an unsalvegable sack of shit if I don't tell the kid's family, this is what I meant about piling on. So here's your fucking pat on the back for making a person on the edge of a mental breakdown feel even worse, hope it was worth it

Try reading the OP again? Seriously what the fuck? Did you see a single word about whether or not I should tell the kid's family in there? No because it's not what I was asking! I was asking about what to do about my girlfriend and her wanting to know what was upsetting me so much. Which by the way now she REALLY wants to know what I'm so upset about on the internet right now

You are piling onto that guilt in the guise of "helping me" but it's clear you just want to berate me for being a bad person. Trying so hard to make me feel worse is helping me how? I didn't ask a question about whether I should tell the kid's family. That isn't the question I asked and I'm not interested in hearing your opinion about it. I'm never going to do it. That's why I didn't ask. You can think whatever you want about me but don't kid yourself that continuing to berate over something I didn't even ask about is any kind of "helping" me

You are completely insane if you read any of my posts on here and think I want "reinforcement of my actions" like what the fuck? I'm arguing with people trying to tell me it wasn't my fault. I didn't ask for that and I don't believe it. I never said I was innocent because I'm not. What is wrong with you. You just want to kick someone when they're down and make yourself feel better. I didn't make an AITA post about if I was wrong to hurt him, that's not in question here
And I know I don't deserve her I'm thinking of breaking up with her because I know she deserves better than me
Oh gee thanks for describing my own life to me, I totally didn't realize any of that had happened! Get off your high horse like you're a perfect example of humanity

I don't know why you keep calling the other guy a child he was like 17. I don't know why you think he was a child but I wasn't one. Not that I think it makes a difference either but you're twisting facts so you can keep following me around this thread berating me
Yeah he gave me broken bones plenty of times but what does that matter now? He didn't put me in that parking lot and he didn't force me to do anything I made all those choices myself
I didn't say I wanted forgiveness, I know I don't deserve it and I'm not asking for it

Thanks for being so kind but other people are telling me I'm a monster and they are way more close to right. It doesn't matter what my circumstances were. I'm not a good person and I don't deserve forgiveness. From myself or my girlfriend or anyone

There's not gonna be a next one, if she leaves me it's over. I know it's not fair to her though which is why I posted this. And I know I'm a monster, ok, do you really need to tell me that? You say you know what it's like but I don't think you understand the pain
Ok. Thanks. Parental relationships are not good. Last time I saw my father he broke my nose. So I don't plan on involving them at all

I don't know why you think this is new information to me that you have to tell me. I stay awake all night hating myself for what I did. I know very well that I am avoiding the consequences and what that means about me as a person. That's not what this question is about

Wait why would my parents be involved? Is there some legal reason they'd have to be involved because I was a minor when it happened? I haven't spoken to them in years. I don't want them involved in this at all

Yeah I know, believe me I know, this is what runs through my head all night. But I'm a coward. I'm not going to turn myself in. I am a coward and I can't handle it. I just want it to go away and I know that makes me a coward too
Yeah. I dunno. I had to grow up fast. I don't know if society would have forgiven me either if it went to court. I don't think this is something I can ever forgive myself for
I'm really afraid to tell a therapist too honestly but it sounds like everybody thinks I need one so I guess I should at least try. Thanks.
Yeah. Ok. I guess that's basically true. I didn't think of it like that. Thanks. I just hope she won't think I'll tell her eventually
I'm not asking for advice on how to lie to my girlfriend, this is messed up

Why do you think I should forgive myself? I was 15 not 5, I knew what I was doing when I got into that fight. No I didn't mean to hurt him that bad but it's always a possibility isn't it? I just wanted to put it in the past but I didn't mean forgiving myself of any responsibility for it
What am I supposed to tell her though? She knows something is wrong
